links.comparator_used: Original ChatGPT responses generated without a reading-level instruction; detailed versus simplified instruction prompts were also compared with each other
links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT responses to knee osteoarthritis patient questions
links.effect: Readability improved slightly after the instruction intervention, with no significant difference between detailed and simplified instructions. Baseline responses significantly exceeded the recommended sixth-grade reading level (p < .001). No numeric post-intervention scores are given in the abstract.
links.quote: After the intervention, readability improved slightly for responses related to knee OA; however, there was no significant difference in readability between the groups receiving detailed versus simplified instructions.
